No middle step

From a free download straight to a call

Someone who finishes Soul at Scale or fills in the toolkit has two choices: book a call about a 90-day engagement, or do nothing. Most people who aren’t ready yet do nothing.

No first purchase

Book buyers belong to the retailer

Soul at Scale sells through Amazon, Barnes & Noble and Bookshop.org. You don’t see who bought it, so you can’t follow up with the readers who loved it.

No filter

Your calendar does the qualifying

Nothing before the call shows you who has already seen how you think and is ready to act. The 30 minutes have to do all of that work, one person at a time.

Anyone who likes your thinking but isn’t ready for a 90-day sprint today has nothing to buy from you, and no next step that tells you they’re serious.

My recommendation

A free masterclass between your book and your calls

You already have the book, the toolkit and the assessment. A free 60-minute class turns that attention into buyers and applications, and the bundle on the thank-you page helps pay for the ads that fill the next class.

Fixes gap 1

A middle step that teaches

The class gives readers and followers a next step between a free download and a 90-day engagement: one hour of your thinking, applied to their practice.

A first purchase you own

The Soul at Scale Bundle sells on your own page, so every buyer becomes a customer and an email address you keep, not the retailer’s.

Only people who watch, stay and apply reach your calendar. They’ve seen how you think, so the 30 minutes start at fit, not at introductions.

They watch the free class, buy the [$37] Soul at Scale Bundle, and stay on your Tuesday Tidbit list. You get paid to start the relationship instead of losing them.

They stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application asks about their revenue and which door fits, and the pre-call emails warm them up for the Practice Rebuild or the Advisory Line.
